Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/k5T0f2XIfpmPO28h/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Goblin Reclaimers [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Goblin Reclaimers v3.5.3 ## Intro Goblins are diminutive creatures using salvaged technology, strange mutations, and sheer weight of numbers. Emerging from their remote planet in the wake of a devastating nuclear blast that wiped out the human colonists on the surface, the Goblins have wasted little time spreading out to nearby worlds and scavenging any technology they find. They are forever seeking new and intriguing life forms and technology, but their penchant for destruction often results in them leaving their new homes every bit as irradiated as their first. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story The Goblins long dwelt deep beneath the surface of their world, emerging to the surface only in times of desperation to forage and hunt what they could from the surface. None know for certain what initially drove them underground; some Goblin legends speak of a great war, but most claim that their ancestors have always lived this way. For much of their history, their world was ignored by the larger species until it came to be settled by a group of Human renegades seeking a world where they could operate outside of the confines of the Great Human Alliance. The Goblins readily embraced their new neighbours, emerging at night to visit the ever-growing Human cities. The Humans and Goblins formed a strange friendship, with Goblins offering help and supplies to the newly settled colonists while the Humans gave them gadgets and tools. Close to a century of collaboration ended with a series of earth-shaking explosions that nearly sealed them forever inside of their caves. Seeking to escape their now crumbling homes, the Goblins fled onto the surface. There, they discovered that the Humans had disappeared but left behind a wealth of technology and infrastructure for them to use, though much of it was badly in need of their unique touch for repairs, and other parts seemed to bring on strange changes in the Goblins. Some saw this as another odd gift left by their former companions, while others exercised greater caution. Remembering that the Humans came from the stars, the Goblins wasted no time in seeking out and assembling space-worthy ships to seek out their companions. Eventually, they did encounter Humans among the stars, but these ones didn’t recognise the Goblins and had little time for their antics, treating them as annoyances rather than friends. Dejected but not unwilling to give up hope of reunion, the Goblins continue to seek out their old friends and new gadgets among the stars, even as many find their chaotic outlook to be more dangerous than endearing. Mischievous, Tough(3) | 90pts | 2 GF - Goblin Reclaimers v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Mischievous:When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons. ## Special Rules Agile:Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge. Bounding:When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Dangerous Terrain Debuff:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Deathstrike:If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. Good Shot:This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting. Instinctive:When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack. Melee Evasion:Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule. Mischievous Boost:If this model has Mischievous, when it shoots or charges enemies over 9" away, enemies taking hits from it must re-roll successful unmodified defense results of 5-6 from Mischievous (instead of only on 6). Quick:Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge. Quick Shot:This model may shoot after using Rush actions. Re-Deployment:After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Retaliate:When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken. Shred:On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Surge:On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Tear:Against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+4). Unpredictable:When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter:When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Shooter:When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Shooter Mark:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Shooter against once (next time the effect would apply). Vanguard:After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position. Vicious:When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons. ## Aura Special Rules Courage Aura:This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Evasion Aura:This model and its unit get Melee Evasion. Mischievous Boost Aura:This model and its unit get Mischievous Boost. Precision Fighter Aura:This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee. Quick Shot Aura:This model and its unit get Quick Shot. Regeneration Aura:This model and its unit get Regeneration. ## Army Spells **Ammo Boost (1):** Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Mischievous Boost once (next time the effect would apply). **Zap! (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. **Mob Frenzy (2):** Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units gets Unpredictable Shooter against once (next time the effect would apply). **Boom! (2):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits with Blast(3). **Shroud Field (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get +1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply). **Pow!
